claims: Nu Stadium is the new 26,700-seat home of Inter Miami CF.
Nu Stadium is located within the Miami Freedom Park development.
Nu Stadium is adjacent to Miami International Airport.
Nu Stadium officially opened on April 4, 2026.
Nu Stadium opened with a match against Austin FC.
Nu Stadium features the Leo Messi Stand.
Nu Stadium has private suites.
Nu Stadium's private suites have private entrances and views.
Nu Stadium has a Fan Zone.
Nu Stadium's Fan Zone is an area for live entertainment, food, drinks, and merchandise.
Nu Stadium was designed by Arquitectonica.
Nu Stadium offers panoramic views of downtown Miami.
Nu Stadium is part of a larger 131-acre entertainment district.
Nu Stadium is the centerpiece of a larger mixed-use project.
The mixed-use project is scheduled to be delivered in phases.
The Miami Freedom Park development includes a 58-acre public park.
The 58-acre public park is named after Jorge Mas Canosa.
The Miami Freedom Park development will feature retail.
The Miami Freedom Park development will feature dining.
The Miami Freedom Park development will feature office spaces.
The Miami Freedom Park development will feature hotel rooms.
Nu Stadium began hosting regular MLS matches immediately upon opening.
Nu Stadium's debut match was on April 4, 2026, against Austin FC.
Nu Stadium's debut match ended in a 2-2 draw.
Nu Stadium's next home match is on April 11, 2026, against the New York Red Bulls.
